title: Astronomers discover a new kind of cosmic object – a black hole ‘star’

paragraphs.en: Astronomers claim to have discovered a new kind of cosmic object, a black hole “star”, which is the size of the entire solar system and glows with a brilliant red light.
paragraphs.zh: 天文学家称发现了一种新型宇宙天体——黑洞“星”，其体积与整个太阳系相当，并发出耀眼的红光。

paragraphs.en: The international team made the breakthrough after focusing their attention on a mysterious red spot in images of the early universe captured by Nasa’s James Webb space telescope.
paragraphs.zh: 这支国际团队在把目光投向美国宇航局詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜所拍摄早期宇宙图像中的一个神秘红点后，取得了这一突破。

paragraphs.en: The object was lurking in the constellation of Cetus, the Whale, billions of light years from Earth. It is thought to have formed 660m years after the big bang, astronomers’ leading theory as to how the universe began.
paragraphs.zh: 该天体潜伏在鲸鱼座中，距地球数十亿光年。据认为，它形成于大爆炸（天文学家解释宇宙起源的主流理论）之后6.6亿年。

paragraphs.en: Measurements of the exotic body found that while it resembles an immense star, it releases 100bn times more energy than any known star can produce. The energy output is far closer to that observed from black holes than stars.
paragraphs.zh: 对这一奇异天体的测量发现，尽管它外表酷似一颗巨大的恒星，释放的能量却是任何已知恒星所能产生能量的1000亿倍。其能量输出与黑洞观测值接近的程度，远超恒星。

paragraphs.en: “We have found a new type of astrophysical object, a black hole star,” said Dr Rohan Naidu who performed the work at the Kavli Institute for Astrophysics and Space Research, part of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. He is now at the University of Hawaii.
paragraphs.zh: “我们发现了一种新型的天体物理对象——黑洞星。”罗汗·奈杜博士说。他在隶属麻省理工学院的卡夫利天体物理与空间研究所完成了这项研究，如今就职于夏威夷大学。

paragraphs.en: It “shines with the energy typically associated with black holes, but at the same time bears signatures classically associated with stars”, he added.
paragraphs.zh: 他补充说，它“释放的能量通常与黑洞相关，但同时又带有通常与恒星联系在一起的典型特征”。

paragraphs.en: The scientists were using the James Webb space telescope to search for the most distant galaxies in the known universe. After succeeding with a galaxy named Mom-z14, which formed a mere 280m years after the big bang, they turned their attention to other cosmic objects.
paragraphs.zh: 科学家们当时正利用詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜搜寻已知宇宙中最遥远的星系。在成功找到名为Mom-z14的星系（该星系仅在大爆炸后2.8亿年便形成）之后，他们把注意力转向了其他宇宙天体。

paragraphs.en: Writing in Nature , the astronomers describe how they focused on an extremely bright red spot known as MoM-BH*-1, the reddest object in the telescope’s image archive.
paragraphs.zh: 天文学家在《自然》杂志上撰文，描述了他们是怎样聚焦于一个名为MoM-BH*-1的极亮红点——这是该望远镜图像档案中颜色最红的天体。
